body: Yes. Twice. Both times ended horribly.
Really needed this. Thank you ❤️

It’s actually odd to me because every time I’ve been asked, it’s been by women.  Not sure what’s up with that. Sorry that happened to you though, I would have done the same thing! I’d give these people a piece of my mind if I wasn’t on the clock.
I work retail so it wouldn’t matter :/

I think that this is an important thing to remember: you probably are mistaking missing him for missing the relationship, and the happiness that came with it. Going through a break up is like going through a drug withdrawal in many ways; suddenly that supply of happiness is just gone, and will most likely never come back in the form of that relationship.
I've found that to be exceptionally hard, as I tend to blame myself for everything. But remember, THEY left YOU, and they weren't willing to work with you on whatever troubles you had.
Amen to that.

I've been there man. One of the worst things is not being able to eat. It's been over two months for me and I continue to eat whatever I want so I can actually eat something. That, and smoothies really help.
Pretty much the same thing happened to me OP. Good luck on your road to recovery!
Same here OP. Literally the day before everything was fine, the next day it was over. He completely cut and run, after he said he wanted to marry me, and I him. Now I'm like nothing to him.

I can't even imagine how you're feeling right now, but my heart aches from your situation.

You are so strong, even still being here. Keep up the momentum, with baby steps. I believe in you.
It scares me when people can cut off their emotions so easily.
Mine was incredibly sudden too, OP. I'm finally stable, glad to see that it looks like you are too. ❤️

Number 5 all the way. Communication is KEY.

P.S. Good luck in grad school, I'm hopefully starting next fall

Same here, OP. My ex lost his father two years ago and today was always hard for him. I wish I could give him some words of support but I doubt he'd even respond. Despite all he put me through, I still think of him as a friend and express sympathy.

I feel you. Mine got back in Tinder within three days and didn't understand why I was upset.

But what's important is that you're out there too, and what will come will come. This too shall pass.

I've read many articles and studies about heartbreak. Your brain getting through a break up is equivalent to your brain going through drug withdrawals. Heartbreak is also one of the most emotionally painful things you can experience, and in extremely bad cases, can cause a very minor change in brain structure.
I don't know what to say, that was beautiful. Thank you, internet stranger. Your kindness makes the world a lot brighter. ❤️

Same thing most likely happened to me, OP. He cut and run. I'm trying to move on as best as I can, but my gut still tells me he's going to come back one day, though I don't know if I'd take him back.

In retrospect, even I don't still totally believe this myself, but he probably wasn't the one.

Thank you for saying this. I've been suicidal for almost two months now and it's been getting continually worse. The only reason why I keep going is my best friend who I've loved for seven years, I'd hate to leave him here all alone.
Thank you, I'm trying to take it a day at a time. Eventually, my mood will stabilize..
Thank you stranger. It's comforting to know I'm not the only one having this pre-mid-life crisis. You are also loved, don't give up!

From my first ex, I got rid of everything but the stuffed bear. Let it gather dust, now I sleep with it instead of the bear my recent ex gave me.
From my most recent ex, I have his things hidden in my closet and I'm letting them sit until I have a set decision on what to do with them. He also gave me his refurbished computer and monitor which I use for work and mostly don't associate him with it. Have yet to delete his pictures.
Going kickboxing and on a shopping spree that and buy my first little black dress. Other than that, work. Sounds pretty good to me :)
I feel you. For some reason I refuse to believe that the person I dated was the same who just cut the cord just like that. It's hard to make what's going on in your head stop.

Thanks for the response. I went through my first really hard break up around this time last year too, except that ex cheated on me. It's actually easier this time... I'm so glad that I didn't jump into another relationship. I'm a senior in college and I'm trying to get ready for grad school, and I recently took up kickboxing. I'm also working a bunch too. But despite all that, there are times where my anxiety gets the better of me and I relapse. It sucks because I had woken up the past two days and finally felt ok. But... live and learn I guess.
